Route Optimizer.description: Daily route optimisation, live traffic re-sequencing and drive-time reporting.

Assist.description: Kitewing Assist — AI copilot built on Gemini: troubleshooting answers from manuals and job history, job summaries, voice notes to work-order text.

Insights.description: Analytics workspace on BigQuery with prebuilt dashboards and data export.

QuickStart.includes: Remote configuration, 2 training sessions, CSV import of customers and equipment.

Standard.includes: Guided configuration, dispatcher and technician training (train-the-trainer), accounting connector setup, go-live support.

Premium.includes: Dedicated implementation consultant, multi-branch design, SSO, 2 weeks hypercare.

discretionary_approval.approver: Deal desk — CEO Dana Whitfield and COO/CFO Marcus Bell

discounts.implementation_discount: Up to 25% with VP Sales approval; never waived entirely.
discounts.notes: Volume, multi-year and nonprofit discounts apply to subscription only and stack multiplicatively before any discretionary discount.

terms.payment: Net 30. Annual plans invoiced upfront; quarterly invoicing available for Growth/Enterprise with ACV of $50,000 or more at no uplift.
terms.price_lock: Prices locked for the contract term; renewals capped at +5% per year.
terms.seasonal: Seasonal technician licences (pest, landscaping) require deal desk approval.
